events.name: Inauguration
events.description: ACE held its Inauguration ceremony for the academic year 2020-21 together with the Valedictory Function for 2019-20. The ceremony was followed by a guest lecture from Mr. Praveen Kumar Purushothaman, Full Stack Developer and Lead Consultant at Virtusa, United Kingdom, who was also the chief guest. Head of Department Dr. R. Anitha was present to grace the occasion.

events.name: Webinar on "What's happening around the Tech Community? Career and Studies"
events.description: Mr. Praveen Kumar Purushothaman, Full Stack Developer and Lead Consultant at Virtusa, United Kingdom, presented a webinar covering trending technologies and full stack development's scope and significance. He advised students on career opportunities, resume/CV preparation, and helped them understand corporate work environments and interview procedures.

events.name: Tech Know Quiz 2.0
events.description: An online technology quiz for 2nd and 3rd year students held over two days, with prelims and finals conducted on the respective days. The event featured four rounds of questions based on technology and associated companies, including a general knowledge round, an image-connection round, a clue-based round, and a chain-elimination round.
events.participants: 41 registered teams attended the prelims; 6 teams were selected for the finals
events.requirements: 4 rounds: General quiz (20 GK questions), Connect Four (guess via 4 images, 150 sec), Archives (5 questions with clues, 120 sec each), Block the Chain (3 questions, 5 images, 5 min each, points for correct answers with no penalty)

events.name: K.ODE
events.description: An online knockout-style coding battle for 2nd and 3rd year students. Opponents were drawn randomly and competed head-to-head across multiple 30-minute rounds on HackerEarth, with the faster/more accurate solver advancing. Day 1 had three rounds; Day 2 held the semi-finals and finals before the winner and runner-up were announced.
events.requirements: Knockout format; participants randomly paired; the competitor solving more test cases in less time advances each round

events.name: 1 Case 1 Pitch
events.description: A case-study pitching event for 2nd and 3rd year students. Participants received case studies via email on Day 1 and pitched their analysis and solutions the next day, with 10 minutes per team (7 minutes pitching, 3 minutes Q&A). Judges Mr. Vignesh Raja (Product Head, WinFluentials) and Mr. Vijay Sai (Alumnus 2018 batch, Solution Engineer at Freshworks London) evaluated the teams on uniqueness, creativity, business concepts, structure, and presentation.

winners.name: Sivasubramanian R, Ugendran R, Suraj Sk
Sai Vignesh, Benita Majo, Amrita josna

events.requirements: Case studies given via email; teams pitched solutions the next day; topics included Vodafone Idea's revenue decline, Twitter's revenue vs user growth, Pizza Hut's bankruptcy, and Netflix's growth drawbacks

events.name: Ace Your Potential
events.description: A mentoring session for 2nd and 3rd year students aimed at preparing them for placements and higher studies. The day began with a seminar on various industry career fields and their technical/soft-skill requirements, followed by a walkthrough of the standard interview process. Students were then grouped by domain preference and assigned mentors for personalized guidance.

events.name: Website Launch Event
events.description: ACE launched its official website (acesvce.in) for 2nd and 3rd year CSE students, one of the department's biggest events that year. The site featured an About Us overview, simplified event registration, a live scoreboard of the top 10 participants across all events, a team member directory, and multiple contact channels for queries.

events.name: Webinar on 'Microservices 101'
events.description: Held right after the website launch, this webinar for 2nd and 3rd year CSE students was delivered by Mr. M. Shanmugarajan (Alumnus, 2015 batch), Senior Python Developer at Mad Street Den. The session focused on the use of microservices in software development and methods for implementing them, closing with a student Q&A.

events.name: Womania
events.description: An online event organized to commemorate International Women's Day for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd year girl students, held in two rounds. Teams of two registered via Google Forms. The first round, "Now Streaming," was a word-guessing quiz using clues, and the final round, "Non-sync," required a participant to speak under constraints while facing elimination for failing to follow them.
events.participants: 16 teams registered and attended the first round
events.requirements: Team of two per registration; two rounds - 'Now Streaming' (guess-the-word quiz) and 'Non-sync' (elimination speaking challenge)

events.name: Interrupt'21
events.description: ACE's National Level Technical Symposium, organized by a team of 15 student event organizers, designers, developers, and volunteers. The inaugural event began at 9:30 a.m. on May 7th, 2021 with a prayer song, welcome address by Vice President Barath, and an address by HoD Dr. R. Anitha. Chief guest Mr. Pravin Shekar (Alumnus 1996-batch ECE), a parallel entrepreneur and marketer, delivered a webinar before the symposium's diverse lineup of events commenced. The valedictory session, led by President Sarjhana R B and Treasurer Seshai Hari, wrapped up the symposium with winner announcements, supported by sponsor Hatch School of Code.

events.name: Webinar on "Why building an individual brand is more important for an engineer?"
events.description: Delivered by Interrupt'21 chief guest Mr. Pravin Shekar, a parallel entrepreneur, outlier marketer, and raconteur, during the symposium's inaugural session. The interactive and informative webinar covered marketing strategies and personal branding, aiming to inspire students to build their individual professional brand.

events.name: Flutter Workshop
events.description: A 2-day Flutter App Development workshop held as part of Interrupt'21, instructed by Mr. Aditya Thakur, a Flutter Developer at STAN known for speaking at Google CrowdSource, GirlScript Pathankot, and other community events.

events.name: Bug! Found
events.description: Participants were given five programming questions in C/C++/Python/Java and had to debug the errors and run the programs. They then had to solve a puzzle using clues derived from the outputs of these programs.
events.requirements: Debug 5 programming questions (C/C++/Python/Java) and solve a puzzle using clues from program outputs; 3 final winners chosen

events.name: Load Your Code
events.description: A generic coding event open for 48 hours where participants could choose any programming language and solve problem statements of varied difficulty within a specified duration of 180 minutes.
events.requirements: Any language of choice; problem statements of varied difficulty; 180-minute duration; 48-hour event window

events.name: Alcoderithm
events.description: An entertaining two-round event testing coding skills and understanding of basic problem-solving operations. In the second round, participants transitioned from solo problem-solvers to direct "battlers" competing against one another.
events.requirements: Two rounds: individual coding round followed by head-to-head battler round

events.name: Bid Coins
events.description: An auction-based event where problem statements and technical stacks were presented for bid, testing participants' problem-solving and pitching skills within a short span of time.

winners.name: Raahul Kalyaan, Janani V
winners.detail: 4th Year, SVCE / Madras Institute of Technology

events.requirements: Auction format; problem statements and technical stacks bid on by teams

events.name: U(I+X)
events.description: An event testing the designing and creative skills of participants. They were given 20 hours to work on UI/UX designs for different themes using their own frameworks.
events.requirements: 20-hour design window; own frameworks; themed design prompts

events.name: Need For Speed
events.description: A fun and interesting event made up of small tasks and challenges spanning multiple areas of Computer Science, designed so that no single domain expertise was required to participate.
events.requirements: Small tasks/challenges spanning multiple Computer Science domains

events.name: Webinar on "Revisiting the Placement Mindset"
events.description: Held alongside the Valedictory ceremony, this webinar was presented by Mr. Tamizhvendan S, Principal Software Engineer at Ajira Tech, Chennai. It inculcated a strong driving force in students for placement preparation and getting their foundational skills right, and was attended by the HoD, ACE coordinators, students across years, alumni, and CSE staff.

events.name: Valedictory Ceremony
events.description: ACE's Valedictory ceremony concluded the 2020-21 academic year, attended by the HoD, ACE Coordinators, students from 1st through 3rd years, alumni, and CSE staff. The HoD addressed the audience, President Sarjhana presented the annual report and winners, coordinators and the President/Vice Presidents shared their experiences, and Mr. Palaniappan delivered the vote of thanks.
